primary_metric: condition-balanced normalized RMSE of cumulative beverage-mass increment
condition_weighting: equal controlled-condition weight; physical brews nested within condition
formal_disposition_rule: no tested evolving form has adoption authority unless practical magnitude, clustered interval, condition consistency, LOBO, corrected blocked-time, processing, complexity, and coverage gates all pass
condition_sign_rule: publish all eleven paired differences and exact two-sided binomial sign probability
high_leverage_rule: publish leave-one-condition-out influence; retain 1-bar in primary

blocked_time.fit_source: other physical brews' 15-60 s prefixes only

invalid_state_rule.penalty_sensitivity: 2 times maximum finite eligible-model error for the same brew

monotone_mass_sensitivity.method: per-brew isotonic regression of aligned mass versus time

successor_rule: EWP-POROSITY-PERMEABILITY-PRIOR-001 after C1 rereview pass and merge
code_hashes: recorded by correction evidence checksum manifest after implementation
model_hashes: recorded by correction evidence checksum manifest after implementation
